name: Return, move in, play it out
summary: Partner serves and plays the third shot; the receiver returns deep, reaches the non-volley-zone line and the rally is played out live; score only the receiving side's rallies.
setup: Partner serves every rally; serve as your rules allow, the serve rules are UNVERIFIED in this app
Receiver returns deep and moves to the non-volley-zone line before the third shot arrives
Play the rally out live; after 10 rallies swap roles
Keep score as rallies won on receive out of 10
success_criterion: Win at least 5 of 10 rallies on receive
safety_notes: Live rallies can include lobs: turn and run back for a lob, never backpedal. Stop if dizzy or in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) AN-02 counts rallies won when receiving, so the drill practises the whole receiving pattern (deep return, move in, fourth shot) under live play and scores exactly that. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
